protocol.calibration_train: Earlier settled Kalshi development outcomes only
protocol.base_train: January-April 2025 Binance; frozen architectures, never fit on September labels
protocol.calibration: Two parameter sigmoid, L2=.01 toward identity, positive slope [0.25,2]
protocol.anchor: Market log-odds offset; intercept, price calibration, external signal disagreement; L2=.1 toward market
protocol.bounds: Anchor intercept [-1,1], market slope correction [-.25,.25], signal disagreement weight [0,.5]
protocol.execution: All evaluation probabilities recomputed on execution rows; original five-second quote availability assumption
protocol.selection: No hyperparameter or trading threshold search; every candidate reported; no automatic promotion
limitations: Reused dates, not a fresh holdout
Only six validation days; uncertainty is exploratory
No initial decision-time intent requirement in quote scenario

uncertainty.note: Exploratory day-block ratios including no-trade days; undefined zero-trade ratios excluded. Fixed historical fills, not a policy replay or reliable six-day edge test.
